info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Carrental Reservations Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Carrental Reservations Status API provides real-time status updates for car rental reservations. This endpoint allows users to retrieve the current status of their bookings, enabling effective management and planning for travelers. Typical consumers of this API include car rental agencies and third-party travel platforms looking to enhance customer experience by providing instant feedback on reservation statuses. By integrating this API, businesses can streamline operations and improve service reliability in the car rental industry.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the current status of their reservations. It provides information regarding confirmed, pending, or canceled reservations, assisting users in managing their bookings effectively.

requestBody.description: The request body for retrieving the status of reservations. This should include the necessary parameters to specify which reservation status is being queried.

204.description: Request completed successfully, no content to return.

ListCarrentalReservationsStatusRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on reservations status. It is expected to be a string that conveys the necessary information regarding the status of reservations.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the operation.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

ListCarrentalReservationsStatusResponse_.description: Response schema for the 'GET' operation regarding the status of reservations.

createdBy.description: The user who created the reservation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the reservation was created by an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Audit information related to the reservation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request, measured in milliseconds. A value of 0 indicates that there was no processing time or the operation was instantaneous.
